title: Palazzo Chigi
visualBrief: Complete principal Palazzo Chigi exterior: all connected mapped ranges around the actual open court; pale five-row Piazza Colonna facade with original alternating pediments,rusticated corner bands,closed arched main entrance and balcony; terracotta hips/chimneys; tall western rooftop loggia,lower western court return and smaller eastern rooftop block. Ground-floor court arcades are genuinely open and deep, backed by closed simplified walls and doorways; the tall closed arched stair window, upper court windows and original plain plaster panels are included. Montecitorio,the column/Piazza Colonna,independent neighboring blocks and interiors remain outside scope. No copied heraldry,sculpture,inscriptions or artworks.
